tools.name: neuronwriter_list_projects
tools.description: List the NEURONwriter projects in the account, with each project ID, name, language and search engine. Start here to find a project ID. Uses no monthly analysis limit. API: POST /list-projects.

tools.name: neuronwriter_list_queries
tools.description: List the content analyses (queries) inside one project, with status, keyword, language, engine and tags. Filter by status or tags to find ready analyses. Uses no monthly analysis limit. API: POST /list-queries.

tools.name: neuronwriter_get_query
tools.description: Get the status of one analysis and, when status is 'ready', its recommendations: metrics (word count, readability), content terms, questions, and the SERP competitors. A new analysis takes about 60 seconds; if status is 'waiting' or 'in progress', call again later. Uses no monthly analysis limit. AP

tools.name: neuronwriter_get_content
tools.description: Get the last content revision saved in the NEURONwriter editor for one query: HTML body, title, meta description, revision date and type. Choose revision_type 'all' to include autosave revisions. Uses no monthly analysis limit. API: POST /get-content.

tools.name: neuronwriter_evaluate_content
tools.description: Score a draft article (HTML or a public URL) against the query's recommendations, without saving it. Use it to check a draft before importing it. Give html or url. Saves nothing and creates no revision. API: POST /evaluate-content.

tools.name: neuronwriter_create_query
tools.description: Create a new content analysis for one keyword in a project. It uses one analysis from the account's monthly limit. Recommendations are ready after about 60 seconds: call neuronwriter_get_query with the returned query ID. API: POST /new-query.

tools.name: neuronwriter_import_content
tools.description: Save article content into the NEURONwriter editor of one query as a new revision. Give html or url; with url, NEURONwriter fetches and parses the page. This writes to the user's editor content. API: POST /import-content.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: neuronwriter_list_projects, neuronwriter_list_queries, neuronwriter_get_query, neuronwriter_get_content, neuronwriter_evaluate_content · Public sink: neuronwriter_list_projects, neuronwriter_list_queries, neuronwriter_get_query, neuronwriter_get_content, neuronwriter_evaluate_content, neuronwriter_create_query, neuronwriter_import_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: neuronwriter_list_projects, neuronwriter_list_queries, neuronwriter_get_query, neuronwriter_get_content, neuronwriter_evaluate_content · Public sink: neuronwriter_list_projects, neuronwriter_list_queries, neuronwriter_get_query, neuronwriter_get_content, neuronwriter_evaluate_content, neuronwriter_create_query, neuronwriter_import_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
